Macrons

Consonantal i

Theme

Money, work & business

save verb

money: spend less, put by

also save money, save up, savings, economise, economize, thrifty

classical

Publ. N 5: Nūllus est tam tūtus quaestus, quam quod habeās parcere.
Cic. Fam. 16.4.2: tē rogō sūmptū nē parcās ūllā in rē

parcō, parcere, pepercī, parsum

verb, third conjugation; with the dative

be sparing with, save (on)

Lewis & Short: “to act sparingly, be sparing with respect to a thing”: to spend less is to be sparing with expense (sūmptū parcere). Publilius has the older accusative. Thrifty is frūgī or frūgālis (Traupman 158).

Other words

  • comparcō (conparcō), comparcere, comparsī — save up, scrape together

    verb, third conjugation, transitive · also used · classical · Ter. Ph. 43–44: quod ille ūnciātim vix dē dēmēnsō suō, suum dēfrūdāns genium, comparsit miser

    (vōx cōmica: Ter.; posteā Fronto)

    Lewis & Short: “to save, husband well, lay up (ante- and post-class.)”; it quotes Terence’s line with the reading compersit.

  • pecūlium, pecūliī n. — savings, one’s own little hoard

    noun, second declension · also used · classical · Verg. E. 1.32: nec spēs lībertātis erat, nec cūra pecūlī; Traupman 174, 374

    Classically the money a slave or a son was allowed to keep as his own; Traupman’s savings bank is argentāria pecūliīs asservandīs.

  • compendium facere — make a saving

    also used · classical · Plaut. Pers. 471: ego hodiē compendī fēcī bīnōs pānēs in diēs

    Lewis & Short: compendium, “a saving or gain, profit acquired by saving (opp. dispendium)”.

Examples

  • Nūllus est tam tūtus quaestus, quam quod habeās parcere.

    There is no profit as safe as saving what you have.Publ. N 5

  • quod ille ūnciātim vix dē dēmēnsō suō, suum dēfrūdāns genium, comparsit miser

    what the poor fellow has scraped together, ounce by ounce, out of his monthly ration, cheating himself of every pleasureTer. Ph. 43–44

  • nec spēs lībertātis erat, nec cūra pecūlī

    I had no hope of freedom, and no thought of savings.Verg. E. 1.32

See also money, save, value.

SourcesLewis & Short: parco · Lewis & Short: comparco · Lewis & Short: peculium · Lewis & Short: compendium
